referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of various components for a ventilation system for an office building with offices only (no kitchen, restaurant or car park). The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 2472 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 5700 m3/h, total weight of the components: 351 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 2.3 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for air valves, air intake, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers and sensors.; UUID: 8b7af501-6c2f-4011-9b6c-9cf8ffd090ea
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Transport to dismantling facilities, machines for handling in sorting plant, electricity demand for sorting plant, final disposal of waste material. Cut-off to recycling for metals.
